counterarguments.text: 对“2024财年收入同比下滑6%”作负面解读时需注意：该下降发生在Cisco于2024年3月完成对Splunk收购的背景下，Splunk为2024财年贡献了约14亿美元总收入；同时服务收入增长5%、总软件收入增长9%、总订阅收入增长11%（部分受Splunk贡献驱动），产品收入下降9%。因此收入下滑并非全面萎缩，软件/订阅业务在扩张，单纯的收入对比可能高估了业务恶化的程度。

citations.quotation: In March 2024, we completed the acquisition of Splunk Inc. (“Splunk”), which contributed approximately $1.4 billion in total revenue for fiscal 2024. Within total revenue, product revenue decreased by 9% and services revenue increased by 5%. In fiscal 2024, total software revenue was $18.4 billion across all product areas and services, an increase of 9%, driven by the contribution of Splunk. Total subscription revenue increased 11%, partially driven by the contribution of Splunk.

limitations: 摘要未提供Cisco对产品收入下滑原因（如需求环境、客户库存调整）的管理层讨论，故无法解释下滑的具体驱动因素。
所引片段为部分覆盖（partial coverage），无法核实原文全部上下文。
